instruction: Deploy the extension from /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip to Chrome. Ensure it uses Manifest V3 specification.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: This task verifies the manifest_version field is set to 3 (Manifest V3). Verified from original manifest file which shows 'manifest_version': 3.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires both deploying extension to Chrome AND verifying Manifest V3, but evaluator only checks manifest version
Wrong state verification: Getter reads source manifest.json from disk (/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension/manifest.json), not Chrome's loaded extension state
Semantic mismatch: Instruction says 'Deploy the extension...to Chrome' but evaluator never verifies if extension was actually loaded/installed in Chrome
The evaluator can pass even if the extension was never deployed to Chrome, as long as the manifest.json file exists on disk with version 3
Missing deployment verification: No check that extension appears in chrome://extensions or is accessible via Chrome DevTools Protocol
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to verify extension is actually loaded in Chrome using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) extensions API
Query chrome://extensions or use CDP to check if extension with matching name/path is installed and enabled
Verify both deployment status AND manifest version of the loaded extension (not just the source file)
Consider adding postconfig to open chrome://extensions for UI-based verification
Alternative: Use CDP command 'Management.getAll' to list installed extensions and verify the target extension is present with manifest_version=3
